snippet.title: Ellsydia - Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Welcome to Ellsydia! A haven of peace awaits you to unleash your building skills. In a medieval fantasy setting, construct, customize, and manage your buildings. Make your village prosper and ensure the well-being of its villagers so they feel happy and fulfilled. 🏡✨

Wishlist now on Steam
store.steampowered.com/app/4159160/Ellsydia/
